_comment: Captured input. Nothing in this file is hand written and nothing here states
an expectation - those live in osv-expected.json, stated separately by hand.
A fixture that derives its own expectation proves only that the code agrees
with itself, which is how a parser that read one field out of the record
passed its tests for a year.
records: real GET /v1/vulns/<id> response bodies. `details` is stripped; it
is long prose and no code reads it.
packages: the id list a package-wide POST /v1/querybatch answers, taken from
which is the same database the API serves.
filtered: what the feed's OWN version filter answered. It is here to be
disagreed with. Asked about golang.org/x/crypto at 'not-a-version' the API
returns 37 ids when the truth is 36.
errors: verbatim status codes and bodies for every failure shape the API
